name: telemt-assistant
description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint and mini-site for a Claude-backed telemt assistant

scripts.package:yandex: rm -f yandex-function.zip && npm ci --omit=dev && zip -qr yandex-function.zip adapters src package.json node_modules && echo 'yandex-function.zip ready'
scripts.check: node tools/generate-schema.mjs --check && node --check src/app.js && node --check src/upstream.js && node --check src/openai.js && node --check src/knowledge.js && node --check src/auth.js && node --check src/site.js && node --check src/schema.js && node --check adapters/cloudflare.js && node --check adapters/vercel.js && node --check adapters/yandex.js && node --check api/index.js && node test/smoke.mjs
